description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a 3/3 Dragon Illusion token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning Whim of Volrath to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon Illusion, adding {U}.
The Dragon Illusion dies, triggering Minn's second ability, putting Grinning Ignus from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.
